reason: Both hypotheses propose substrate preheating to reduce thermal gradients, but Candidate A is more specific and testable: it defines a clear baseline (conventional AM without preheating), a measurable predicted outcome (lower residual stress, reduced segregation, improved strength and ductility), and a decisive falsification experiment. Candidate B introduces an unsupported specific temperature range (200–300 °C) without justification and cites evidence (E1, E2) that is not directly on AlCrFeNiSi or the proposed mechanism, weakening its grounding.
